title: Tool execution report
description: Gives credit for the specific execution of a data analysis tool.

report_format_version.description: The version of the execution schema used.

affiliation.description: Identifier of the project associated with this tool execution. Ideally from the Research Organization Registry (ROR) https://ror.org/.

tool_identifier.description: Tool identifier from bio.tools, an RRID, or other source. Multiple identifiers can be supplied for tools known to multiple registries.

tool_name.description: What the tool author calls the tool.

tool_version.description: Version of the tool that was actually run, ideally captured from the tool itself or a packaging system (apt, conda, pip, etc..).

tool_package_version.description: Version of the tool as reported from a packaging system (apt, conda, pip, etc..).

input_size.description: The total size of the inputs, MUST be (rounded or binned, details TBD).

infra.description: Physical and virtual infrastructure providers involved in the coordination, planning, and/or execution of this tool. Could be platforms, service providers, etc.

location.description: Physical location where the computer was. Don't really care more than city/country.

name.description: The name of the physical location where the computation took place.

addressRegion.description: The region in which the locality is, and which is in the country. For example, Baden Wuerttemburg or another appropriate first-level Administrative division.

addressLocality.description: The locality in which the street address is, and which is in the region. For example, Freiburg im Breisgau

cpu_identifier.description: For example, the 'model name' field from /proc/cpuinfo on Linux.

cpu_mods.description: For example, the 'bugs' field from /proc/cpuinfo on Linux.

cpu_cores_assigned.description: Number of CPU cores that were assigned to the tool.

start_time.description: Time & date of the beginning of tool execution.

end_time.description: Time & date of the end of tool execution.

duration.description: Duration of tool execution. Using start_time & end_time is preferred.

final_outputs_size.description: Disk usage (bytes), MUST be (rounded or binned, details TBD).

memory_used.description: Peak memory usage, measured in bytes.

cpu_cores_used.description: Measured number of CPU cores used.

infra_name.description: Name of the infrastructure (who should get credit).
